title: Codimension Reduction of Minimal Submanifolds with Flat Normal Bundle in Spheres
summary: Let $x:M^n\to\mathbb{S}^{n+q}$ be a minimal immersion of a complete connected manifold with flat normal bundle, where $n\ge3$ and $q\ge2$. We prove that if the squared norm of the second fundamental form $S$ satisfies $S<2n$, then $M^n$ lies in $\mathbb{S}^{n+1}$. The standard minimal products of three spheres show that the upper bound $2n$ is optimal. We also prove a codimension reduction theorem under the condition $S+λ_2\le 2n+\frac{2n}{3n-2}$, where $λ_2$ is the second largest eigenvalue of the Gram matrix of the shape operators, implying that $M^n$ lies in $\mathbb{S}^{n+1}$.
